items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: Can you tell us some more about your lessons with Teo... When I first started, Teo impressed, always impressed it... He showed me how to finger that particular passage.

ctx.x: And that's about all that you've got on. Can you tell us some more about your lessons with Teo and your counting and rhythm?

When I first started, Teo impressed, always impressed it. You had to keep your foot. For whole notes, four beats. For a half note, two beats. A quarter note, one beat. But I always had to keep that foot going while I was playing my exercises. I had to keep the foot going to keep it on time. And then later on after I started playing with the little bands around Chicago, then the drums. Then you've got the tempo and the beat from the drums. I mean the drums inspire you to play, you know. Can you tell us a little more about Teo? Did he play clarinet with you at the lessons? Did he have his instrument there to demonstrate, or did he do all of them?
